name: The Last BBS Session
description: A retro BBS gateway has gone quiet, and its access token is missing. Recover the token from a service on the lab network. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.

tasks.name: Recover the gateway token
tasks.description: The archived BBS gateway needs its missing access token. Find and recover it from a service on the lab network. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.
hints: Compare what the unusual ports say when you connect; a port number does not guarantee a protocol.
Look for a familiar file-transfer greeting and try its standard control commands.
Check the service's name-only directory listing, then retrieve the archive record it reveals.
